mission: Build the Swiss query-specific visual legal research product while minimizing repository-owner attention: broad retrieval -> sourced generative answer -> independent counter-authority search -> interactive jurisprudence map. Autonomous agent cycles/compute are cheap; owner attention is scarce.

corpus.question: PAUSE — LEGACY CORPUS COMPLETE AND PRESERVED. The 174k corpus, section extraction, BGE/bger crosswalk and historical artifacts remain valid research evidence/fallback data, but are no longer on the MVP critical path. The canonical Swiss source for the new query-specific product is OpenCaseLaw public infrastructure. Re-open corpus only if the MVP exposes a concrete missing data capability that OpenCaseLaw cannot supply.

legal-distance.question: PAUSE — UNIVERSAL 174k LEGAL-GEOMETRY RESEARCH IS NO LONGER THE PRODUCT CRITICAL PATH. Preserve all accepted and negative results. Do not resume dense 174k embedding/citation-heritage work for the MVP. Re-open only if query-specific retrieval/map tests show a specific representation deficiency that cannot be solved with free lexical/citation/open-source methods.

fractal-map.question: PAUSE — GLOBAL 174k FRACTAL MAP AND BLOCKER_PRODUCT_JOIN_ALIGNMENT_V1 ARE SUPERSEDED AS MVP BLOCKERS. Preserve existing clustering/rendering code and artifacts for reuse, but do NOT spend cycles repairing the universal id→cluster join unless the query-specific product later requires it. Product may selectively reuse projection/clustering/WebGL/LOD components.

evaluation.question: QUERY-MAP MVP EVALUATION supporting product autonomously. Build/maintain the smallest executable frozen benchmark that improves the product without consuming owner attention: relevant-authority recall, contrary/limiting-authority recall, source validity, FR/DE/IT robustness, duplicates, cached reproducibility, latency and cluster stability. Reuse prior LexMachina multilingual/jurist-preference/boilerplate/provenance methodology where useful. Do not rerun obsolete universal-174k geometry work. Evaluation must feed concrete fixes to product automatically and must not ask the owner for methodological micro-decisions. Human judgment is reserved for the final UX/product gate.

product.question: BUILD THE QUERY-MAP MVP in docs/product/QUERY_MAP_MVP.md with OWNER-ATTENTION as the scarce resource. Continue autonomously until there is a genuinely usable local end-to-end artifact: Swiss legal question -> OpenCaseLaw retrieval/cache -> query_result_bundle -> reranking -> sourced generative answer using free OpenCode or a local model for development/testing -> independent counter-authority search -> query-specific clickable map with clusters/outliers/decision details/relation edges and visible contrary/limiting authorities. REUSE-FIRST: adapt the existing LexMachina server/cache/API shell, navigation, TF-IDF, clustering/projection, WebGL/Canvas, LOD/culling and tests rather than rebuilding them. Do NOT block on universal 174k alignment, dense 174k embeddings, global citation-graph reconstruction, global fractal hierarchy, custom model training or 3D polish. No arbitrary agent-cycle limit while executable progress continues. Technical failures, library/layout/model choices and repairs are autonomous; do not ask the owner to babysit them. Development/testing must be possible without requiring the owner to provision a paid API, but future production inference may be paid, local or hosted. Next normal human gate = clickable product ready for real legal-research testing; escalate earlier only for a genuine unavoidable owner-level product/business/legal/external-access decision.

director_note: HUMAN CLARIFICATION 2026-10-11 direction v43: owner attention, not agent compute or elapsed autonomous cycles, is the scarce resource. Continue the query-map pivot. Free/local/OpenCode is required only so development/testing can proceed without asking the owner to buy/provision APIs; future production inference may be paid/local/hosted. Reuse the month of existing LexMachina work aggressively. Product/evaluation remain RUN; legacy global-map lanes remain PAUSE. Do not impose arbitrary cycle-count kill rules; reroute autonomously while measurable progress continues. Next ordinary owner interaction should be a clickable end-to-end product test.
